stem.text: The diagram shows the logarithm of the first 13 ionisation energies of an element.

stem.alt: Graph of log ionisation energy (y-axis) against number of electrons removed, 1 to 13 (x-axis), for the first 13 ionisation energies of an element. The points rise steadily with a jump after 4 and a larger jump after 12.

A.text: A proton is lost for each successive ionisation energy.

D.text: The element has only one outer electron.
